study.name: Retest: Phase 3a: H3 Consensus Voting — Track 1 (Image)
study.description:
Tests consensus voting at elevated temperatures (T=0.3, T=0.7, T=1.0) using
the carry-forward plus-hp library configuration (F1=0.609 at T=0.0).
T=0.0 is excluded because the plus-hp library produces near-deterministic
output at zero temperature, making consensus voting meaningless (Erratum E32).

Consensus voting is evaluated post-hoc by pooling K independent single-pass
runs (per preregistration Section 3.8) at pool sizes N=5, N=10, and N=30,
sweeping vote threshold x=1..N for each. The key question: does any
(T, N, x) configuration beat the T=0.0 single-run baseline (F1=0.609)?
study.retest_notes: H3 consensus voting Track 1 (image-using). K=30 for full threshold sweep.
